welcome.heroSubtitle: Visually design directives for Cursor, GitHub Copilot, and Claude Code. Real-time preview and seamless export without touching manual markdown.
welcome.templatesSubtitle: Select your project's technology stack to preload idiomatic directives and quality standards.
welcome.featureClientDesc: No backend, no accounts. Your directives live solely in your browser.
welcome.featureSyncDesc: Instant visual preview of the compiled file in real time.
welcome.featureExportDesc: Copy to clipboard or download your ready-to-use file.

presets.typescriptDesc: Modern TypeScript ecosystem (Angular, React, Node.js). Strict typing, immutability, and clean patterns.
presets.pythonDesc: FastAPI, Django, and AI services. Mandatory type hints (PEP 484), Pytest, and Clean Architecture.
presets.goDesc: Concurrent systems and high-performance APIs with decoupled interfaces and zero memory leaks.
presets.rustDesc: High-performance safe code with strict borrow checker adherence, Result<T,E>, and clippy.
presets.javaDesc: Robust enterprise development with Spring Boot 3, DDD, immutable records, and JUnit 5.
presets.customDesc: Universal clean configuration without presets to define your agent from scratch.

targets.cursorDesc: YAML Frontmatter directives optimized for Cursor IDE
targets.agentsDesc: Open standard for autonomous coding agents with build & test commands
targets.claudeDesc: Concise operational contract for Claude Code CLI
targets.customDesc: Universal development directives contract in Markdown
